commits.author: Alex
commits.subject: upgrade_test: wait for SL v2 after topology upgrade in TWCS upgrade test upgrade_test wait for SL v2 after topology upgrade in TWCS upgrade test - upgrade_test.py now follows the same raft-topology upgrade flow used in enterprise_upgrade_test.py - test_upgrade_cluster_nodes_with_twcs no longer assumes the cluster always starts in gossip topology - once the cluster reaches 2026.1+, the test waits for schema-on-raft completion, enables raft topology, and waits for service levels v2 before continuing - this avoids continuing the upgrade flow while the cluster is still transitioning to post-raft procedures Slightly fuller version: This change applies the same topology-upgrade handling from PR #6785 to `test_upgrade_cluster_nodes_with_twcs`. After all nodes are upgraded to a version that supports raft topology, the test now: - checks whether consistent topology changes are already enabled - waits for schema-on-raft upgrade completion - enables raft topology when needed - waits for service levels v2 before proceeding This prevents the TWCS upgrade test from racing ahead during the topology transition, which started failing after pre-raft topology removal. Fixes: [SCYLLADB-1199](https://scylladb.atlassian.net/browse/SCYLLADB-1199)
